proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.modify_roll_substitute
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature is a passive floor/substitution on completed Strength checks and Strength saving throws. The current surface has numeric modifiers and advantage/disadvantage riders, but no honest way to replace a roll total with a minimum value derived from an ability score.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If your total for a Strength check or Strength saving throw is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.

notes: Top-level fit is class_feature + passive. I did not author a placeholder content file because any current encoding would be misleading: this is neither a flat bonus nor advantage, and set_ability_score targets ability scores rather than roll totals. The missing concept already exists in v4 taxonomy as modify_roll_substitute, so this is a surface widening, not atom widening.
